name: @rhizomatics/signalk-datalab-plugin
description: Interactive data analysis notebooks for SignalK, using Marimo running as WebAssembly in the browser. ALPHA, use with caution. See also signalk-cli on PyPi.

scripts.build:wasm: node scripts/build-wasm.js && npm run build:wheel && npm run build:icons && cp notebooks/CLAUDE.md public/
scripts.build: npm run build:ts && npm run build:wasm
scripts.agent: uv run --with-requirements requirements.txt --with "marimo[mcp]" marimo edit notebooks/signalk.py --watch --mcp --no-token --port 2718
scripts.lab: uv run --project packages/ibis-signalk --with-requirements requirements.txt --with "signalk-cli[feather]" marimo edit . --watch

author: jey burrows
